record.paper_title: Recent progress and open problems in the Bergman space
record.original_question: Let omega be a positive C-infinity smooth weight on the closed unit disk that reproduces the origin for bounded harmonic functions, meaning h(0) = integral_D h(z) omega(z) dS(z). Suppose omega satisfies Delta log omega(z) >= -1/(1 - |z|^2)^2 in D. Is the Green function Gamma_omega(z,zeta) for the weighted biharmonic operator Delta omega^(-1) Delta positive on D x D?

evidence.quote: CONJECTURE 4.4 Let omega be a positive C-infinity-smooth weight

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D} = \{z \in \mathbb{C} : |z| < 1\}$ denote the open unit disk and let $dS$ denote normalized area measure on $\mathbb{D}$. Let $\omega : \overline{\mathbb{D}} \to (0,\infty)$ be a $C^\infty$-smooth positive weight on the closed unit disk with the reproducing property at the origin for bounded harmonic functions:
$$h(0) = \int_{\mathbb{D}} h(z)\,\omega(z)\,dS(z)$$
for every bounded harmonic function $h$ on $\mathbb{D}$. Suppose moreover that $\omega$ satisfies the curvature condition
$$\Delta \log \omega(z) \;\geq\; -\frac{1}{(1-|z|^2)^2}, \qquad z \in \mathbb{D},$$
where $\Delta$ is the standard Laplacian. Let $\Gamma_\omega(z,\zeta)$ denote the Green function for the weighted biharmonic operator $\Delta\,\omega^{-1}\,\Delta$ on $\mathbb{D}$ with Dirichlet boundary conditions (so $\Gamma_\omega(\cdot,\zeta)$ and its normal derivative vanish on $\partial\mathbb{D}$, and $\Delta\,\omega^{-1}\,\Delta_z\,\Gamma_\omega(z,\zeta) = \delta_\zeta(z)$).

Prove or disprove: under the above hypotheses, $\Gamma_\omega(z,\zeta) \geq 0$ for all $(z,\zeta) \in \mathbb{D}\times\mathbb{D}$.
artifact.status_search_result: Positivity of the Green function for weighted biharmonic operators $\Delta\omega^{-1}\Delta$ has been established for various special families of weights (radial logarithmically subharmonic weights, weights of the form $|z|^{-2\alpha}$, certain rational weights), beginning with work of Hedenmalm and continued by others. However, the general conjecture under the curvature hypothesis $\Delta\log\omega \geq -(1-|z|^2)^{-2}$ does not appear to have been resolved; recent literature continues to treat positivity for restricted weight classes and notes the general case as open.

status_evidence.title: The Green functions for weighted biharmonic operators of the form Δω−1Δ in the unit disk
status_evidence.snippet: Green function is nonnegative everywhere when the weight w is radial, logarithmically subharmonic, and area integrable.
status_evidence.claim: Positivity is known under restricted (radial, log-subharmonic) hypotheses, indicating the general conjecture remains the broader open problem.

status_evidence.title: Construction of Green functions for weighted biharmonic operators
status_evidence.snippet: Studies positivity for weights of form |f|^{-2λ}; positivity in general remains unresolved.
status_evidence.claim: General positivity for smooth weights satisfying the curvature condition is not established.

status_evidence.title: A computation of Green functions for the weighted biharmonic operators Δ|z|^{-2α}Δ
status_evidence.snippet: Hedenmalm computed Green functions for Δ|z|^{-2α}Δ with α>-1.
status_evidence.claim: Only special weight families have been completely treated.
